title: Meet GROMACS
story: GROMACS runs molecular dynamics: it simulates how a protein moves in water. Every GROMACS tool is a subcommand of one program, `gmx`, which comes from a module. Load it and find out which version of GROMACS Geiss-01 has. Type the version number in the answer box.
hints: `module load gromacs` puts `gmx` on your PATH.
`gmx --version` prints the version and how it was built.
The version is on the line `GROMACS version:`. `module list` shows it too.
